'''October 2000 Green Bay tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at HobbyTown USA, Green Bay, Wisconsin on 14 October 2000. [[Matt Upstone]] won it. It is known from Mark Kloida's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1355">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-16-gb-10-14d1355/ gb-10-14], DeckTech (Mark "yodarth" Kloida, 16 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-16-gb-10-14d1355/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 14 October 2000
* '''Site:''' HobbyTown USA, Green Bay, Wisconsin
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Players:''' 20
* '''Winner:''' [[Matt Upstone]]
